description: Key Vault Contributor / management rights - modify the vault's access policy or RBAC to grant yourself data-plane access, then read its secrets.
prerequisite_privilege: Key Vault Contributor (or Owner/Contributor) on the vault
abuse_primitive: Add an access policy / RBAC assignment for yourself (Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/accessPolicies/write), then read secrets (see AZGetSecrets).

telemetry.detail: Azure Activity log records the vault/access-policy write (Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/write, .../accessPolicies/write). Default-on and a strong tell - self-granting vault access is anomalous.
Defender for Cloud (Key Vault plan) alerts on suspicious access-policy changes and anomalous vault access; paid plan.

notes: The management-plane access-policy change is default-logged and high-fidelity; the subsequent secret read (AZGetSecrets) is quieter.
